projectDescription: A Python desktop tool that searches Google Sheets beneficiary records across multiple IMDEL social programs by DNI, with both a CLI and a Tkinter GUI interface.
keyFeatures: DNI-based beneficiary lookup across 7 Google Sheets worksheets in a single query
Automatic DNI normalization for sheets with mixed-format DNI fields
Tkinter GUI with threaded connection and real-time status (interfaz_prueba.py)
On-demand data refresh without restarting the application
Multi-program coverage: Oficina de Empleo, Desarrollo Agrario, Capacitación Laboral, Inserción Laboral, Plan Fines, Economía Popular
publicApiSurface: gspread.service_account(filename) — authenticates with Google Sheets via service account
proyecto_sheets.get_worksheet(index) — accesses individual worksheets by index
worksheet.get_all_values() — fetches all rows from a worksheet
actualizar_bases() — reloads all worksheet data from Google Sheets
BuscadorApp.__init__(root) — initialises the Tkinter GUI application
BuscadorApp.buscar_dni() — runs a DNI search across all configured worksheets
BuscadorApp.actualizar_bases() — triggers a background data reload
_limpiar_recorte(valor, min_len) — normalises DNI values with extra leading/trailing digits
_limpiar_solo_digitos(valor, min_len) — strips non-digit characters from a DNI value
SHEETS_CONFIG — list of worksheet descriptor dicts (nombre_interno, worksheet_index, col_dni, limpiar, min_len, formatear)
